items.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Unveils Global Stock Grants As Brian Niccol Maps Drive Thru Reset
items.summary: Starbucks (NasdaqGS:SBUX) announced new global employee compensation programs on 13 November 2026, including stock grants and quarterly bonuses. CEO Brian Niccol outlined a turnaround strategy that focuses on fresh menu concepts and a comprehensive reinvention of the drive thru format. The refreshed drive thru model is planned as a global template for future store development and operational changes across key markets. items.title: Lutnick Under Fire as Bessent Blames Commerce for Nvidia Crisis
items.summary: Denver Riggleman, CEO of RIIG Technology, said that it is 'mind boggling' that anyone would defend Jensen Huang's actions as he faces the personal, political and legal fallout from his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Riggleman, who served in Congress as a representative from Virginia, said that lawmakers who want to get real answers from both Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick should call on intelligence experts to advise them on their line of questioning.

items.title: Starbucks’ Unusual Options Activity Points to Bullish Institutional Sentiment: Should You Follow the Crowd?
items.summary: Massive institutional options activity surged in Starbucks (SBUX) on Thursday. A $96.3 million block trade used deep in-the-money calls for a short-term stock-replacement strategy. At the same time, LEAPS are used more often; the institution that made the bet could profit nicely.
